description: Eligible voter freeze: who may vote is fixed when the vote opens.

cases.inputs: Meeting with active Chair and active Member; roles: [Chair, Member].
preconditions: Meeting with an active Chair and an active Member who may read it.
cases.return: Both user ids, distinct and ordered.

cases.inputs: Meeting with an active Member who has not marked attendance; roles: [Member].
preconditions: Meeting with an active Member who may read it and has no attendance row.
cases.return: The Member id; attendance plays no part.

cases.inputs: Meeting with an active Chair and a deactivated Member; roles: [Chair, Member].
preconditions: Meeting with an active Chair and a deactivated Member.

cases.inputs: Meeting with an active Chair; roles: [Guest].
cases.return: Empty list; the vote cannot open (MSG220).

precondition: Meeting with participants and roles; selected eligible roles.
